curation_notes: L-Aspartate (Asp). Natural substrate. Product is oxaloacetate.
L-Glutamate (Glu). Natural substrate. Product is alpha-ketoglutarate (2-oxoglutarate).
L-2-Aminoadipic acid. One extra methylene vs Glu. Product is 2-oxoadipate.

L-Arginine measured at ionic strength mu=0.2. Same compound as 'Arginine (mu = 1.0)' row — different kinetic conditions, not a distinct substrate. Guanidinium pKa ~12.5; SMILES written with uncharged guanidine. Physiologically the guanidinium carries a +1 charge. Protonation state should be standardized before modeling. When building ESOREX training data, deduplicate or average both Arg rows.
L-Arginine measured at ionic strength mu=1.0. Same compound as 'Arginine (mu = 0.2)' row. See that row for protonation and deduplication notes.
L-4-Methylphenylalanine. Para-methyl Phe analog. Product is 4-methylphenylpyruvate.
L-Phenylalanine (Phe). Primary natural substrate of eTATase. Product is phenylpyruvate.
m-Tyrosine (3-hydroxyphenylalanine). Meta-OH on benzyl ring. Positional isomer of tyrosine (para). Product is 3-hydroxyphenylpyruvate.
L-4-Methoxyphenylalanine. Para-methoxy Phe analog. Product is 4-methoxyphenylpyruvate.
L-4-Aminophenylalanine. Para-amino Phe analog. The ring amino is a passenger side-chain feature distinct from the alpha-NH2. Product is 4-aminophenylpyruvate.
L-Tryptophan (Trp). Natural substrate. Indole NH is unmapped (passenger). Product is indolepyruvate.
L-Tyrosine (Tyr). Para-OH Phe. Natural substrate of both enzymes. Product is 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate.
L-DOPA (L-3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine). Catechol ring. L-form assumed; verify against paper if uncertain. Product is 3,4-dihydroxyphenylpyruvate (dopapyruvate).
o-Tyrosine (2-hydroxyphenylalanine). Ortho-OH on benzyl ring. Positional isomer of tyrosine (para) and metatyrosine (meta). Product is 2-hydroxyphenylpyruvate.
L-4-Nitrophenylalanine. Para-nitro Phe analog. Nitro group written with formal charges [N+](=O)[O-]. Product is 4-nitrophenylpyruvate.

O-Phospho-L-tyrosine. SMILES written as fully neutral phosphate (pKa1~1, pKa2~6). At physiological pH the phosphate carries one negative charge (mono-deprotonated). Protonation state must be standardized to match assay conditions before modeling. Product is the phosphotyrosine alpha-keto acid.
L-Alanine (Ala). Natural substrate. Methyl side chain. Product is pyruvate.
L-2-Aminobutyric acid (Abu). Ethyl side chain. Product is 2-oxobutyrate.
L-Norvaline. n-Propyl side chain. Product is 2-oxopentanoate.
L-Norleucine. n-Butyl side chain. Product is 2-oxohexanoate.
L-2-Aminooctanoic acid. n-Hexyl side chain (6 carbons). Product is 2-oxooctanoate.
L-Leucine (Leu). Natural substrate. Isobutyl side chain. Product is 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate.
L-Valine (Val). Natural substrate. Isopropyl side chain. eAATase kf/KD and kf both 'ND' (not detected) in the paper — treated as missing (empty) in curated CSV. Product is 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate.

CHA: abbreviation is ambiguous. Interpreted here as cyclohexylalanine (2-amino-3-cyclohexylpropanoic acid, beta-cyclohexylalanine). Alternative: cyclohexylglycine (2-amino-2-cyclohexylacetic acid). Given the 'Branched alkyl side chains' category and analogy to Leu, cyclohexylalanine is the most likely identity, but verify against Onuffer 1995 text. Product is 3-cyclohexyl-2-oxopropanoic acid.
